module: Execution engine of a running campaign. It holds the active campaign (local variable campaign = {meta, state}), chains scenarios based on the "nextScenario" key or the onSucceed/onFail events, holds the status of each location (state ready/failed/completed, medal, attempts), checks prerequisites (completed scenarios, required vehicle), handles rewards, comics, achievements (OnlineServiceProvider.unlockAchievement), the end screen (retry/next/cancel/menu/freeroam/finish buttons) and serialization. Locations are in meta.subsections[s].locations[l]; a location's key in state.locationStatus is "subsection.location".
notes: Location types (info.type / info.subtype): "site" with subtype transitionPoint, playerHQ or missionGiver; "race" with subtype timeTrial. isScenarioLocation = type different from "site" and subtype different from "timeTrial".
Campaign ends: isCampaignOver is true if the next scenario key is "END" or absent; processNextScenario then shows the summary (ui_router "scenario.chapter.end") and stops the campaign.
In scenarioFinished, a location's status is only updated if the subtype is not "timeTrial" and if the location is "ready" or if the new medal is better (statistics_statistics.getMedalRanking).
Bug: M.onDeserialized = onDeserialized exports a variable not defined in the file (nil).
Bug: uiEventRetry is defined but empty and is not exported; the Retry button calls scenario_scenarios.uiEventRetry().
isOverallResultFail always returns false; displayCampaignSummary also shows hardcoded values (community = 20, player = 78, achievements "Not Implemented").
rewardSelectionCallback reads campaign.state.scenarioRewards.choices.vehicles: only the choices under the "vehicles" key are therefore handled.
scenarioStarted and scenarioFinished ignore scenarios whose name differs from campaign.meta.scenarioName.
A required vehicle (dataType "vehicles") is compared with the model and config of the player's current vehicle (extractVehicleData).

onDeserialized.desc: Always nil: reference to a variable not defined in the file.

getOwningSubsection.desc: Returns the campaign subsection that contains the given location.

isCampaignOver.desc: True if the scenario has no next scenario (key "END" or absent); false as long as it has no result.

startScenarioFromKey.desc: Loads (if not provided) and launches a location's scenario: updates currentLocation, scenarioKey, activeSubsection, saves the campaign then calls scenario_scenarios.executeScenario. Logs an error if the location is unknown.

processedScenario.desc: Scenario already loaded; otherwise loaded via scenario_scenariosLoader.loadScenario(location.path).

stop.desc: Forgets the current campaign (local variable set to nil).

canStartScenario.desc: Checks a location's prerequisites (requires field): all the listed scenarios "completed" in the same subsection, and/or the player's vehicle in the required list.

returns.desc: true if the scenario can start.

isLocationCompleted.desc: True if the location has the "completed" state.

canImproveResult.desc: True if the medal obtained for this location is not already "gold".

execEndCallback.desc: Calls the end-of-campaign callback (meta.endCampaignCallback) only once, if it exists.

markCompleted.desc: Marks a location as "completed" in locationStatus.

scenarioStarted.desc: Called by the scenario system at startup: in the "pre-start" state plays the location's onIntro event (comic, inventory) and increments the location's attempts counter.

scenarioFinished.desc: Called at the end of a scenario ("post" state): updates the location's status and medal, computes the rewards (campaign_rewards.processRewards), builds the end screen buttons, unlocks achievements and plays the onSucceed/onFail events.

scenario.desc: Finished scenario with result and stats.

rewardSelectionCallback.desc: Callback called by the UI when the player chooses a vehicle reward; stores the index in state.selectedRewardIndex.

uiEventCancel.desc: Cancel button of the end screen: hides the menu (guihooks MenuHide), navigates to "menu" and stops the scenario.

uiEventNext.desc: Next button of the end screen: applies the reward choice, stops the current scenario and launches the next one; shows the summary and stops the campaign if there are no more. Ignored (warning) if no campaign is active.

getCampaignActive.desc: Indicates whether a campaign is active (state.campaignActive).

getSubsection.desc: Returns a subsection by key (nil if no campaign is active).

getLocationData.desc: Returns a location's data in a subsection.

getActiveSubsectionLocationData.desc: Like getLocationData but in the active subsection.

getCurrentLocation.desc: Returns state.currentLocation (format "subsection.location") if a campaign is active.

isTransitionPoint.desc: True if the location is a site of subtype transitionPoint.

isPlayerHQ.desc: True if the location is a site of subtype playerHQ.

isMissionGiver.desc: True if the location is a site of subtype missionGiver.

isSiteLocation.desc: True if the location is of type "site".

isScenarioLocation.desc: True if the location is neither a "site" nor a time trial (subtype timeTrial).

isSubsectionMarker.desc: True if a location in the subsection has entryMarker or exitLocation equal to the given marker name.

startCampaign.desc: Activates the prepared campaign (state.campaignActive = true), sets currentLocation to meta.startingLocation, plays onStart then starts execution (first scenario). Does nothing without meta.startingLocation.

resumeCampaign.desc: Resumes a saved campaign: replaces campaign.state with data and restarts execution at the current location.

onSerialize.desc: Serialization hook: returns campaign.state with sourceFile, or {} if no campaign is active.

onSaveCampaign.desc: Save hook: calls saveCallback(M.__globalAlias__, campaign.state + sourceFile).

onExtensionUnloaded.desc: Hook called when the extension is unloaded: stops the campaign.

onScenarioChange.desc: Scenario change hook: unloads this extension if no campaign is active.

onResetGameplay.desc: Gameplay reset hook; does nothing in this version.
